## About
Allies Automotive is a family owned and operated repair shop at 11230 Slaughter Creek Drive in south Austin, run by owners Chris and Michele Kato. Phil Rossi and Stephen Ross round out the team in the shop.
We're a little off the beaten path, but our neighbors on the south side keep making the drive. We handle general maintenance, general auto repair and engine installations, and we'd rather explain what's going on with your car than sell you work you don't need.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 97 Google reviews, and many of them mention the same thing: honest advice at a fair price.

## Services
- General maintenance: Routine care to keep your car or truck running well.
- General auto repair: Repairs for cars and trucks, with a clear explanation of what needs doing and what doesn't.
- Engine installations: Engine installation work handled in our shop.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Our regular hours are Monday through Friday. Weekends are available by appointment only, so give us a call to set something up.

Q: What if my car can't be driven to the shop?
A: Tow service is available around the clock through Round Up Towing at 512-280-2803.

Q: Who runs Allies Automotive?
A: We're family owned and operated. Chris and Michele Kato own the shop.
